vortigal.notes: Clean key, full body, wings inside frame. Small on canvas but fine.

kindrel.notes: Strong fox, ember markings read fire, tail tip has margin, no halo.

nykra.notes: Clean mane and tail edges, full body.

ouroth.notes: Dark ember serpent, clean edges, full coil.

brazgor.notes: Reads fire, distinct from earth; clean fringe.

umbrel.notes: R2: no halo on light bg, base now fades into a soft ground contact, full body with margin, painterly mushroom-root reads earth. Minor pale slivers at the left and right feet on dark bg; acceptable at game scale.

hyalia.notes: Full body, clean wing membrane edges, no halo.

quarrak.notes: Painterly shell, clean key, full body.

glimmaw.notes: Teal shell and skin read water, clean edges.

zephra.notes: Wing tip near left edge but not cropped; keep at least 6px margin on final canvas. Clean key, feather edges soft and acceptable.

abyssor.notes: Smudge not visible at sheet scale; clean tentacles, full body. Optionally zero alpha under 8 to kill faint grey.

durrok.notes: Moss-stone elephant, full body, trunk inside frame, clean edges.
